# LeadingZeros 〔BlitzLLVM〕

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Math](BlitzBasic-Math)

```blitzbasic
LeadingZeros:Int32 value:Int32
```

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

<!-- AUTOGENERATED COPYRIGHT HEADER START -->
Counts the bits that are 0 before the first 1, from the highest bit down. A number of 0 has all of its bits counted. This is a BlitzLLVM extension. It looks at the bits of the number the way its type has them, so the same value counts differently as a `Byte`, an `Int` or a `Long`: a number written in the program is an `Int` (32 bits) unless it is larger, and `Byte`, `UByte`, `Short`, `UShort`, `UInt`, `Long` and `ULong` give the other widths. A real or a text is taken as an `Int`, like the bit operators do.

```blitzbasic
Print LeadingZeros(1)
Print LeadingZeros(UByte(1))
Print LeadingZeros(Long(1))
Print LeadingZeros(0)
```

```text
31
7
63
32
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | Int32 | required | An integer. |

**Returns:** How many of the highest bits are 0.

**Differences and known gaps:**

* Not in the originals.
